grades: Entering freshman year of high school through freshman year of college
pay_detail: Free to students. A deposit confirms your spot and is returned on the day of the program (amount not stated).
duration: One-day camps in fall (the weeklong camp is over for 2026)
notes: The Oct. 11 close date is figured from the "10 days prior" rule on the flyer, so check the Columbus registration page. Sign up on the page for email notices about future ExploreAg camps.
name: ExploreAg (Ohio Farm Bureau career camps)
city: Ohio (one-day camps in Columbus, Wilmington, Findlay and more)
what_you_do: Hands-on one-day camps and a weeklong camp in summer. They show you jobs in food science, crops, farm tech, food making, animal care and more. Fall 2026 includes a Columbus day on Oct. 21.
who_can_apply: Any Ohio student who is entering 9th grade through 12th grade, or freshman year of college, this fall.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 one-day camps: Wilmington Oct. 13, Columbus Oct. 21, Findlay Nov. 3, COLT Lineman Training (Mount Gilead) Oct. 23, Meat Processing (Yorkshire) Oct. 27. Registration closes 10 days before each event, so the Columbus day closes about Oct. 11, 2026.
how_to_apply: Pick the camp on the ExploreAg page and fill out its registration form. For questions, use the Contact Us page at ofbf.org/contact/.
